description: Capability for sticky note pop-out windows (spec.md subtask 8), each labeled "sticky-<id>" by lib/stickyWindow.ts. default.json's capability only covers the "main" window, so these windows need their own grant to get any permissions at all - sql:* for lib/db/stickyNotes.ts's CRUD, plus close/set-always-on-top/set-size (core:window:default alone is read-only) for StickyNoteTopBar.tsx's Exit/Pin/shrink-on-blur behavior (spec.md subtask 9), plus clipboard-manager:* (spec.md subtask 11/12) since the image editor also opens from sticky notes.
